scoring_justification: Agent only outputs final enthalpies; recomputing from raw artifacts is not possible, so result-level comparison against paper gold with tolerance is appropriate.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold enthalpy values for LiNbO3 and LiTaO3
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text (end of Section III): 'The enthalpy for the interchange in LiTaO3 is 2.3 ± 0.5 eV/atom, and the enthalpy for the interchange in LiNbO3 is 2.2 ± 0.5 eV/atom.'

outputs.description: JSON object containing the computed standard-state enthalpy changes for the Hf site-interchange reaction in LiNbO₃ and LiTaO₃.

output_contract.notes: The digitised occupancy ratio data table will be provided in instruction.md. The enthalpies are compared against hidden paper-reported values with a tolerance that accounts for fitting variability.
